attachments.origin_landmark: inferior cartilage of the pharyngotympanic (Eustachian) tube
attachments.insertion_landmark: blends with palatopharyngeus in the pharyngeal wall

actions: opens the pharyngotympanic tube during swallowing

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Raises the salpingopharyngeal fold. Its tubal action is part of why swallowing equalises middle ear pressure.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
